description: This file defines the DwarfCFIToModule class, which processes parsed DWARF call frame information and populates a google_breakpad::Module object with it. It includes nested classes for error reporting and register name tables, and declares methods for handling DWARF call frame rules.

classes.name: DwarfCFIToModule
classes.description: Class that converts parsed DWARF call frame info into a Breakpad Module object.

classes.name: DwarfCFIToModule::Reporter
classes.description: Nested class for reporting errors during DWARF to Breakpad conversion.

classes.name: DwarfCFIToModule::RegisterNames
classes.description: Nested class providing register name tables for different architectures.

methods.name: Entry
methods.description: Handles a new DWARF call frame entry.

methods.name: SameValueRule
methods.description: Handles a rule where register has the same value.

methods.name: OffsetRule
methods.description: Handles an offset rule for a register.

methods.name: ValOffsetRule
methods.description: Handles a value offset rule for a register.

methods.name: ExpressionRule
methods.description: Handles a register rule with an expression.

methods.name: ValExpressionRule
methods.description: Handles a register rule with a value expression.

methods.name: End
methods.description: Finalizes the call frame info processing.

methods.name: RegisterName
methods.description: Returns the name of a register given its number.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Records a rule for a register at a specific address.
